draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.20, the 84th-best grade among 261 2022 draftees and 9th of 37 at CB. He lasted until pick 109, well after his grade rank (84th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: P.J. Williams. Testing concerns: 40-yard dash (12th percentile). College production: 11 passes defended in 2021, 4th of 31 CBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 5 pro, currently with the Chicago Bears (reserve). 58 career games and 34 starts over 4 completed seasons. His 2025 season (6 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: passer rating allowed 54.0 (98th percentile), interceptions 4 (96th percentile), season snap share 87.1% (88th percentile). Weak spots: missed tackle rate 21.4% (2nd percentile). Versus the typical Year-4 cornerback who played: 87.1% season snap share against a median of 34.8%, above the norm.
